entities.name: Antónia Ferreira

entities.summary: Antónia Adelaide Ferreira, often referred to in Portugal as "Ferreirinha", was a Portuguese businesswoman. She is known for leadership in the cultivation of port wine and for the winemaking innovations she introduced to Portugal.
